integrity: Algebraic proof for the parameter continuum; rational and floating-point diagnostics only supplement the proof. The original orbit-construction formulas and map are credited to Lozi.
scientific_limitations: Local, strict Q4-to-Q2 period-two orbit only; no global basin, hyperchaotic-attractor, other-itinerary, or unequal-coefficient conclusions; no independent priority certification.
title: Sharp sink–saddle transition and an exact elliptic center at a symmetric three-dimensional Lozi two-cycle
